title: 12th Sefer Torah Hakloli to Be Completed in Buenos Aires
blurb: In an exciting announcement, the committee for the Sefer Torah Hakloli announced that the siyum of the 12th Sefer Torah Hakloli will take place next Sunday, 14 Cheshvan, at La Rural, a major 45,000-square-meter exhibition and convention center in Buenos Aires, Argentina, featuring distinguished guests including Israeli Chief Rabbi Rabbi Kalman Bar .

title: The Rebbe Saw East Flatbush’s Potential 64 Years Ago
blurb: Three newly published letters reveal the Rebbe's remarkable assessment of East Flatbush, his personal initiative to secure funding for its mikvah, and his strong insistence that its construction could not wait.

title: Popular Gemara Shiur Moves to New Crown Heights Location
blurb: A popular weekly Gemara shiur by Rabbi Peretz Kaplan and organized by The New Beis Medrash has moved to a new location, giving yungelait in Crown Heights an opportunity to set aside time from their busy schedules and come together once a week for Torah learning.

title: Chassidus and Academia Collaborate at Stanford University
blurb: Co-sponsored by Stanford University and IJSS, the conference brought together Chassidic scholars, academics, and prison reform practitioners to explore the Rebbe's vision of human dignity and transformation.
